value.body: A degree in business management. You study accounting, economics, marketing, finance, human resources and operations, often with case studies, projects and an internship. Well-known BMS programmes run at University of Mumbai colleges and the University of Delhi; the content is close to a BBA.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4-year honours option at some universities under NEP 2020

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream, though some universities ask for Mathematics. In Maharashtra, admission uses the state CET for BHMCT/BCA/BBA/BMS/BBM. The University of Delhi uses CUET-UG, with Mathematics among the required subjects.

value.title: At a glance
items: The content overlaps heavily with a BBA; the name differs by university.
Entry roles are usually in sales, marketing, operations, finance or HR.
An MBA or MMS, often after some work experience, is one route to manager roles.
